(a) arithmetic: CEX_day = CEX_year/365.25 is 1.450x smaller than CEX_year/252 (252/365.25 = 0.690); /365 differs from /365.25 by 0.07%.
    VEX per 1 vol point = VEX per 1.00 vol / 100 (vanna is dDelta/dSigma with sigma in decimals). Both are pure unit choices; nothing predictive turns on them.
